text:
mira (AE): Sentinel Systems sent over a POC checklist. Main asks: parity with CompetitorX, streaming chunk behavior, and a completed security questionnaire. Can team triage?

ben (SE): send their sample request/response pairs. Most diffs are tokenization + model/version defaults. We can offer a shim and a token-normalized view.

mira (AE): sample (redacted):
POST https://api.competitorx.io/v1/completions
{"prompt":"Summarize:
- loved the feature...","max_tokens":120}
They report CompetitorX returns 38 completion_tokens; our runs show ~48 and wording is more verbose.

tara (security): questionnaire highlights: SOC2, customer-managed KMS, VPC/dedicated option, 12+ month audit log retention, and a pentest allowance.

ben (SE): plan: (1) provide client-side shim mapping CompetitorX envelope to Redwood API so their integration switch is minimal; (2) produce token-mapping report and a conversion heuristic; (3) enable low-latency streaming config to match smaller chunks.

kai (infra): can provision a tiny Dedicated pool for POC (1 GPU equiv) and enable streaming.chunk_target_bytes=8kb. Need their staging IPs and target region for VPC peering.

mira (AE): procurement asked about a short reserved discount for a 6-week POC. Could offer a POC promo—say 20% off with a 6-week reserve.

tara (security): I'll fill the questionnaire; need vendor legal name and pentest contact.

infra-bot: Provisioned poc-sentinel-01 in eu-west-1. streaming.chunk_target_bytes=8192. Audit logs retention=13 months.

mira (AE): next steps: Ben -> shim + eval harness with their prompts by Fri; Kai -> VPC allowlist + pentest window; Tara -> questionnaire back by Mon; Mira -> pricing proposal and schedule demo.

ben (SE): if parity still off after shim, propose small finetune or deterministic param recipe (temp/freq_penalty) as optional line item.

mira (AE): thanks all, i'll loop in the prospect with demo invite.
